cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; a sunny concrete skate park of smooth bowls and ramps — frames a shot on a smartphone held out in both hands; a beach club of white daybeds and parasols on the sand — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a dark jellyfish room — slips the corner of a freshly printed instant photo into an album; a sunlit white marble temple — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a cinema lobby with a popcorn counter — crouching down low; a small open pavilion with upturned eaves perched on a sheer mountain cliff above a sea of clouds — sitting on the ground; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — reclining on her back; a steel catwalk high inside a giant hangar — crouching down low; a cinema lobby with a popcorn counter — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the boarding stairs of a small plane on a sunny airfield — pulls a hard-shell travel suitcase along behind her by its handle
